g.text: KayaRank5Convo1 begins.

g.title: j2303412939
g.text: I keep finding these purple things, but they disappear like the next day.

g.title: j2722006167
g.text: And I'm thinking there's something to their decay.

g.title: j472954500
g.text: Because the matter isn't just reforming into a decay state of a new isotope.

g.title: j1451913650
g.text: It's actually disappearing from HERE.

g.title: j1478039336
g.text: Do you mean Cryotic?

g.title: j4087148389
g.text: Do you mean Argon Crystals?

g.title: j1029857743
g.text: Mmm nope, not that.

g.title: j2134663103
g.text: That's gotta be it!

g.title: j1177832308
g.text: Do you mean Orokin Cell?

g.title: j10844647
g.text: Do you manage to keep them around where you're from?

g.title: j3669800433
g.text: Mmm nope definitely not that either.

g.title: j1571924371
g.text: They always disappear once you bring them out of the Void.

g.title: j1649441858
g.text: Never, I always assumed they just decayed.

g.title: j34110614
g.text: Do you mean Rubedo?

g.title: j1610815111
g.text: Do you mean Argon Crystals?

g.title: j1174761406
g.text: Well that's just it - in the Void they are inert.

g.title: j3092735924
g.text: I don't think so, if we can't figure it out I might never solve this.

g.title: j2647686825
g.text: And when they leave the Void, they always return to the Void. They don't decay into new matter.

g.title: j2508427408
g.text: Do you mean Nano Spores?

g.title: j3300412236
g.text: They phase back into the Void. The Void is everywhere, calling it back.

g.title: j2128224429
g.text: Ugh oh no, the last sample I had is gone. I ... ugh. I have to go.

g.title: j221969447
g.text: Boolean KayaFutureWin2 is now true.

g.title: j3359845337
g.text: I don't think I can do this.

g.title: j245028682
g.text: Will this get you out of 1999? Planning on hiding in the Void? I wouldn't recommend it.

g.title: j1393166029
g.text: Is this important to your goal?

g.title: j4123196853
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j3785290916
g.text: It's more about the states of matter and the theory that the Void isn't 'linear' in a our understanding, so I can use it as a trampoline to effectively follow YOU back.

g.title: j3243428120
g.text: Very very very! It means matter has a connection between the VOID and HERE. Atoms, Matter, they are CONSISTENT in both areas.

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank5Convo2.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank5Convo2.

g.title: j4123196853->Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank5Convo2.
j1430811758
g.text: Wait follow me?

g.title: j463960890
g.text: The Void isn't 'linear' by our understanding, so I can use it as a trampoline to effectively follow YOU back.

g.title: j530138779
g.text: Yup, no matter how many times I run tests or equations, I'm missing a 'lighthouse' so to speak. The trampoline jump needs to land somewhere, and if you've even gone back once it should be enough to calibrate to.

g.title: j3297634810
g.text: I hope you can backflip! One lighthouse coming right up.

g.title: j2773374038
g.text: Woah I don't know if I'm comfortable with this. What if you get stuck or lost?!

g.title: j1354946202
g.text: I'm not quite ready yet of course. Measure twice, cut once. Measure... 1000 times.

g.title: j3765071042
g.text: I won't.

g.title: j3793971863
g.text: Fair enough, science is best done with confidence.

g.title: j3662275049
g.text: Let's try! No time for caution, let's go now!

g.title: j505355337
g.text: You might.

g.title: j2545308215
g.text: I'm teaching you well, I see.

g.title: j3368813067
g.text: Ahh no no I'm not ready! You can't rush this!

g.title: j396703659
g.text: Nope.

g.title: j2985487533
g.text: You wish!

g.title: j4249208809
g.text: Oh sure, you're a great teacher. Although I think the only thing I've seen you do is teach Minerva how to play new drinking games.

g.title: j2347237762
g.text: Finnne, seems you still realize how dangerous this could be. Well done.

g.title: j1954827812
g.text: Sigh...

g.title: j2297686569
g.text: But... you might.

g.title: j611684691
g.text: Minerva with a hangover is more dangerous than time travel though. RUN!

g.title: j1812728294
g.text: Minerva with a hangover is more dangerous, though. RUN!

g.title: j160782031
g.text: You'd find me.

g.title: j2950468032
g.text: Don't put that on me...

g.title: j3339257061
g.text: No take backs!
